estimator.name: eta squared (SSB / SST), raw descriptive between-player share
estimator.formula: SSB = sum_i n_i (mean_i - grand)^2; SST = sum (y - grand)^2; eta2 = SSB / SST
estimator.units: share of observed variation in apex_retention that sits between players
estimator.not_the_icc: This is not the ICC(1). The ICC(1) is the ratio of the between-player variance component to total variance under the one-way random-effects model; eta2 is the observed descriptive share and the two quantities are different.

precision_note: The quoted point is computed in the parquet's stored precision (float32). A float64 recomputation gives 0.0176795498; the two differ by 1.2e-09.

ci.method: player-level cluster bootstrap, percentile interval (players resampled with replacement, whole turn sets kept)

ci_20000.method: player-level cluster bootstrap, percentile interval (players resampled with replacement, whole turn sets kept)

note: The planning figure quoted [1.31%, 2.30%]; our 2,000-rep draw gives its own interval [1.27%, 2.29%] and the 20,000-rep run is [1.30%, 2.31%] — the same estimator, differing in the second decimal only by Monte Carlo draw.

icc_committed.statement: 0.003382 is the ratio of the between-player variance component to total variance under the one-way random-effects model (ICC(1)); it must not be described as the share of variance between players.
